headline: Ultimate Tic-Tac-Toe: Pure Vanilla JS Mind Games
text:
Think Tic-Tac-Toe is solved?

Try Ultimate Mode: a nested 9x9 board where every move dictates your opponent's next sub-board.

Built in pure vanilla JS with minimax AI. Zero ads, instant load:

https://kreeda.games/ennead/index.html

#gamedev #webdev
mediaSuggestion: A 5-second fast-paced looping GIF showing an intense Ultimate Tic-Tac-Toe sequence: placing an 'X' in a sub-grid, highlighting the forced next grid, and triggering a satisfying meta-board capture animation in dark mode.
